title: Not Age-Specific...Enough
text:
Receiving Allure's Beauty Box for 3 months was undeniably fun. Their customer care is also very sweet. Products come packed in clear-color pouches and after my first pouch arrived split up the side, Allure's Customer-Care apologized & w/i 3 weeks, sent me an intact pouch.

I cancelled my subscription, however, bc products seemed designed more for younger women. And that's not to say there aren't women 60+ who'd love the drama of glittery skin, ultra-long false eyelashes or bright-orange lip stain (that doesn't easily come off). I'm just far happier with products designed for more mature skin...& we know the marketplace is full of those. I did end up subscribing to IPSY for beauty/skincare collections. They are able to customize based on age.
label: neutral
